newsitem.title: USA: Weeks Corp says sets public offering. [CORRECTED 22:33 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Weeks Corp says sets public offering. [CORRECTED 22:33 GMT]

text.p: Weeks Corporation said on Monday it will offer 3.2 million shares of its common stock (corrects to show this is a number of shares not dollars) and use the proceeds of that sale to repay debt and fund acquisition activities.
Weeks is a real estate investment trust that owns and acquires industrial and suburban office buildings.
The offering was expected to raise $99.3 million, based on the closing price of Weeks common stock on April 18, the company said in a statement.
It said that proceeds of the sale will be used to repay indebtedness, including $31.2 million of mortgage indebtedness, and to provide funding for the company's committed investments.

"The offering announced today will put the financing in place for committed investments which we believe will produce attractive returns for the company, will give us substantial additional capacity, and will position us to complete successfully our broader capital strategy which includes pursuing an investment-grade rating," said chief financial officer David Stockert.
